description: Product-specific temperature stability and excursion impact assessment
why_it_is_not_closed: Requires the customer's product portfolio and stability data; no generic assessment is valid
interim_control: Excursion records capture duration and peak; disposition requires a qualified person

description: Hazard analysis and CCP identification for the customer's process
why_it_is_not_closed: Depends on the customer's process flow and hazards
interim_control: Template and monitoring controls provided; HACCP team completes and signs the plan

description: Supplier approval and incoming-goods verification records
why_it_is_not_closed: Held by the customer's quality system
interim_control: Supplier register template referenced in retention guidance

description: Calibration certificates for the customer's reference instruments
why_it_is_not_closed: Issued by the customer's calibration laboratory to their assets
interim_control: Registry stores certificate SHA-256 and due date; blocked release on expired calibration

description: Customer regulatory registrations and facility licences
why_it_is_not_closed: Held by the operator and jurisdiction-specific
interim_control: CRA and audit evidence references the operator's records

description: Legal counsel review of compliance wording and templates
why_it_is_not_closed: Requires qualified counsel; cannot be self-certified
interim_control: Kit is marked DRAFT and the packaging gate blocks a release archive

description: Accredited assessor review of IEC 62443 SL2/SL3 and CRA claims
why_it_is_not_closed: Requires an accredited assessment body and on-site evidence
interim_control: SL targets and gap list are stated as claims to verify, not as certification

description: Physical environmental qualification of the gateway enclosure
why_it_is_not_closed: Depends on the selected enclosure and installation site
interim_control: Environmental limits and bench evidence in docs/reference-hardware.md

description: Physical HIL execution against customer instruments and PDU
why_it_is_not_closed: Commercial lab campaign per docs/hil-test-procedure.md; software bench already passes
interim_control: The evidence pack documents the exact case list; DRAFT labels until the lab run completes

why_it_is_not_closed: Depends on the signed support agreement and staffing
interim_control: Template defines targets; current repository support is best-effort

description: SBOM attached to each customer-specific build
why_it_is_not_closed: Generated per release by CI; customer build needs the release artefact attached
interim_control: Release pipeline publishes SBOM and VEX for tagged releases

description: Customer data-retention schedule and legal basis
interim_control: Retention guidance gives defaults and an export/erase procedure
